meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 装上后,会用 Microsoft Graph 给 AI 代理建 Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal、Agent Identity,并配置凭据、权限与 OAuth 令牌交换(fmi_path、OBO、跨租户)。
howto.when: 当提到 Agent Identity Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal、代理 OAuth/fmi_path 等,或要求管理 AI 代理的 Entra 身份/权限时触发。

say.text: 为代理建 Blueprint,并建 BlueprintPrincipal。
say.note: Claude 会通过 Graph API 建蓝图和服务主体。

say.text: 给 agent-2 单独授予 User.Read.All 应用权限。
say.note: 权限按 Agent Identity 单独授予。

say.text: 配置 fmi_path 两步交换,目标为代理身份的 home tenant。
say.note: Claude 会按两段流程做父令牌到 Graph 令牌交换。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude provisions Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, configures credentials/permissions, and sets up OAuth2 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth/fmi_path, or asks to manage an AI agent's Entra identity/permissions. Not for standard app registration.

say_en.text: Create an agent Blueprint and its BlueprintPrincipal.
say_en.note: Creates the blueprint and service principal via Graph API.

say_en.text: Grant User.Read.All to agent-2 as an Agent Identity.
say_en.note: Scoped per Agent Identity, not to the blueprint principal.

say_en.text: Configure a two-step fmi_path exchange to the Agent Identity's home tenant.
say_en.note: Claude performs the parent-to-Graph token exchange.
